title: `userOid` used in risk service queries but never declared — TS compile error + ReferenceError at runtime
Risk `navigateTo: /risk-register/:id` — no `[id]` dynamic route exists; all risk task "Open" links 404
description:
**Files:** `risk-management-service/src/routes/internal-tasks.routes.ts:164`

**Root Cause:** `navigateTo: \`/risk-register/${doc._id.toString()}\`` — the `/risk-register/` Next.js directory has no `[id]` dynamic segment. Confirmed routes: `/risk-register/accepted-risks`, `/risk-register/evidence`, `/risk-register/module-risks`, `/risk-register/treatments`. No `/risk-register/[id]` page exists. Every risk task "Open" link produces a Next.js 404.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Determine the correct deep-link for a risk item. Check if the risk-register page accepts a query param (e.g., `?riskId=<id>` or opens a drawer). Most likely fix:
```ts
navigateTo: `/risk-register?riskId=${doc._id.toString()}`,
```
Or if the risk center has a detail view:
```ts
navigateTo: `/risk-center?riskId=${doc._id.toString()}`,
```
Confirm by reading `vibrantix-client-panel/src/app/(private)/risk-register/page.jsx` to check how individual risk items are opened (modal, drawer, query param).
